Name: Cantrip of Endurance
Text:
DOUBLE YOUR LIFE
FOR THIS FIGHT

Relic.Name: Enduring
Relic.Draw: a red spirit bison made of glowing red light, head lowered and massive shoulders squared to the viewer, standing its ground, its shaggy edges dissolving into mist

Relic.Name: Mighty
Relic.Draw: an orange spirit rhinoceros made of glowing orange light, charging toward the viewer with its horn forward, its hindquarters dissolving into mist

FOR THIS FIGHT

Relic.Text: Ice cards deal 3x DMG for this fight.

Name: Cantrip of Ward
Text:
TWO SHIELDS OF RANDOM

FOR THIS FIGHT

Relic.Name: Warded
Relic.Draw: a mother-of-pearl spirit turtle made of glowing pale pearly light, its high domed shell of large faceted plates shimmering with soft orange, blue, yellow, green and purple sheens, in a strong three-quarter view with its head raised toward the viewer, its flippers dissolving into soft mist
Relic.Text: Two shields of a random color every turn, for this fight.
